canonical_operator.A_hat: unique positive-semidefinite square root of G_c
canonical_operator.normalization: none; source functional-response magnitudes are retained

noise.edge_rule: all four adjacent-checkpoint chains plus replica pairs a0-a1 and b0-b1 at every checkpoint
noise.prompt_variance_role: candidate behavioral signal, excluded from lambda_measurement

retention.fit: mean soft projector over the fit quadrant
retention.cell_score: Hilbert-Schmidt cosine between fit mean and evaluation-cell soft projector
retention.aggregation: minimum over all evaluation cells and four reciprocal crossfit directions

null.construction: independent block-Haar quadrant frames preserve every local spectrum and 4/4/4 context blocks while breaking cross-quadrant identity
null.threshold: 95th percentile of the maximum central-window null retention per draw

bootstrap.band: max-absolute-deviation simultaneous band across all 17 lambda values

decision.pass: Every central-window condition strictly clears its margin: d_eff range < 1.0, simultaneous bands have positive common-intersection margin, observed-minus-null retention > 0.05, informative fraction > 0.20, median anisotropy > 0.10, and the audit null is valid.
decision.fail: At least one valid-instrument condition strictly crosses its adverse boundary: d_eff range > 1.0, common-intersection margin < 0, observed-minus-null retention < 0, informative fraction < 0.20, or median anisotropy < 0.10.
decision.inconclusive: Every valid-instrument outcome between pass and fail, including equality.
decision.not_evaluated: The null calibration or provenance is invalid.

claim_boundary: This target-blind gate tests whether a gauge-invariant soft behavioral response geometry is stable above replica/checkpoint measurement noise in the existing Qwen3-1.7B primitives. It does not identify coordinated weight-space edits, use behavioral outcomes, authorize signed edits, measure recursive improvement, or establish RSI.
